subject: HSM onboarding, escrow proofing, and crediting roadmap
messages:
From: David Liu <david.liu@medsentry.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsentry.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding fees, escrow proofing & HSM seat vs. consumption question

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is keen to move forward but procurement has two sticking points they want clarified before we get legal involved:

1) How are you treating the HSM/KMS costs during onboarding vs. recurring? We need a clear amortization path for our finance team (CapEx vs. OpEx).
2) We asked for an escrow/evidence package for our auditors — what level of artifacts do you provide and can that be tied to a one-time implementation credit?
3) If we take the hosted plus a dedicated HSM seat, is there a blended discount you can offer if we commit 12 months upfront?

Attaching our SOW draft (MedSentry_SOW_v1.pdf). Looking for a short roadmap and numbers so we can brief CFO and procurement on Tuesday.

Best,
David
David Liu
Director of IT, MedSentry
Procurement: procurement@medsentry.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: David Liu <david.liu@medsentry.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding fees, escrow proofing & HSM seat vs. consumption question

David — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the SOW. I've looped in Ben (pricing) and Laura (implementation) to make sure we give you an actionable roadmap. High level answers now, formalizing numbers in an attached offer PDF.

Summary answers:
- HSM/KMS economics: we can split charges into a one-time onboarding/implementation fee (covers initial HSM setup, attestations, and evidence packaging) and an ongoing HSM seat fee for dedicated on-prem/HSM hardware or a per-usage uplift for hosted-managed keys.
- Escrow/evidence: we provide an evidence bundle (attestation checklist, SOC-lite artifacts for the onboarding period, key lifecycle docs) as part of the onboarding package. We can map delivery milestones to credit milestones.
- Blended discount: yes — for a 12‑month committed MPL + 1 dedicated HSM seat we can offer a blended discount on the seat and a staged onboarding credit leading to a net effective discount in year 1.

Attached: redwood-compliance-offer-20250915.pdf (proposed numbers, crediting milestones, and a sample evidence checklist).

Next steps I propose:
1) We capture MedSentry's preferred capital treatment (one-time vs amortized).
2) Ben to share a simple workbook (onboarding-credit-workbook.xlsx) showing example amortization scenarios we can present to your CFO.
3) Laura to confirm timeline and deliverables for the evidence bundle.

If this works, I'll send a short, redlined term sheet and a DocuSign for the onboarding milestone schedule.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: FW: MedSentry pricing posture — draft approach (internal)

Internal — quick pricing note for the proposed structure. Putting thoughts here so Sean can pick numbers that balance CFO appetite and company economics.

Options (illustrative):
A) One-time implementation credit approach
   - Onboarding implementation fee: list $60k, with a $40k credit if they sign 12 months upfront (net first-year implementation: $20k).
   - HSM dedicated seat: $3,500/month; with 12-month commit reduce to $2,800/month (effective annualized seat discount ~24%).

B) Amortized treatment (finance-friendly)
   - Spread onboarding over 12 months as a monthly credit against the seat/usage line (easier for CFO to treat as Opex). Example: $45k spread as $3,750/month credit offset for first 12 months.

C) Hybrid (what I recommend)
   - Small implementation fee ($25k) to cover setup & evidence delivery; a separate amortized credit of $30k applied monthly as a discount to usage/seat for 12 months. This preserves cash and reduces perceived CapEx.

Notes: evidence/escrow delivery has a fixed cost on our side (engineering & legal time) so we want some portion as one-time. Recommend option C as negotiation start.

I'll prepare the workbook with example P&L treatment; Sean, if you want I can include a 'break-even' table showing when the customer sees net savings vs. list pricing.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Operations
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: David Liu <david.liu@medsentry.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@medsentry.com
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding fees, escrow proofing & HSM seat vs. consumption question

David — following up with a proposed, negotiable package based on Ben's recommendation. Key numbers are in the attached PDF and workbook but summarizing here so you can present to CFO: 

Proposal (negotiable):
- One-time implementation fee: $25,000 (covers HSM onboarding, key ceremony, and evidence bundle delivery).
- Amortized implementation credit: $30,000 applied as a monthly credit across the first 12 months (netting against seat or usage).
- Dedicated HSM seat: $2,800/month with 12-month prepay (list: $3,500/month).
- Evidence bundle delivery: milestone 1 (initial attestation) at go‑live; milestone 2 (evidence package) within 30 days of production — both mapped to the credit schedule.

We believe this hybrid keeps your auditors happy (we deliver the evidence artifacts up front) and keeps the finance impact as Opex through the amortized credit. If CFO prefers pure CapEx treatment, we can adjust by shifting more of the credit into the one-time fee.

Next steps:
1) If these numbers look OK, I'll issue a short commercial term sheet and the DocuSign for the onboarding milestone schedule.
2) Laura will follow up with the detailed implementation timeline and exact deliverables in the evidence bundle.
3) Ben will attach the workbook showing the amortization scenarios for your finance team.

Happy to hop on a 20‑minute call with CFO/procurement tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182
